note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Three contests, Castlebalfour, Lisnaskea and Ballindarragh; the Unionists won all three. The uncontested divisions are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Completed 7 Nov 2026 (meetings-fermanagh1930) from the Fermanagh Times nominations report (8 May 1930, p. 8, read on the page image): 26 divisions returned unopposed; Brookeborough, missing from that list, is taken from the Fermanagh Herald's list (10 May 1930, p. 3). Where the two papers print a name differently, the contest note gives both. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Drumshemuck' to Drumshimuck (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Drumshimuck; the rounds were filed as Drumshemuck (1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1961, 1964); Drumshamuck (1939). This round was filed as 'Drumshemuck', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (drumshemuck) answers with a redirect to this one.
